info.description: A section displaying multiple feature highlights, service badges, or customer testimonials.

adminDisplayTitle.description: Internal name to identify this features/testimonials section in Strapi admin lists.

contentType.description: Select whether this section displays service features/benefits or customer testimonials.

title.description: Main title heading of the features or testimonials section.

badge.description: Top badge or tag displayed above the section title (e.g. 'WHY CHOOSE US').

description.description: Short subtitle or introductory text below the section heading.

headerStyle.description: Header title and badge typography style (e.g. style-1, style-2).

style.description: Layout and card grid style identifier (e.g. style-1, style-2, style-3).

features.description: List of feature cards (icon, title, description) displayed when Content Type is 'features'.

testimonials.description: List of customer reviews (author, avatar, rating, feedback) displayed when Content Type is 'testimonials'.
